items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we didn't know, in a quartet – we knew Chick was going to show, but you definitely held your own, and Eddie took some solos that were just amazing.

ctx.x: I know, but we all know Chick’s going to do that, but we didn’t know, in a quartet – we knew Chick was going to show, but you definitely held your own, and Eddie took some solos that were just amazing.
Yeah, Eddie’s just – I told you, his mic was turned way up. I wish I could get them to turn my mic up that strong.

I remember that gig specifically because you were getting slapback, because they hadn’t really tuned the sound system, because it was so new. The hall just opened up. Chick was really trying to get them to get the sound right.
